title: Hasselblad XPan Dual-Format Panoramic 35mm Camera
purpose: Panoramic 2.7:1 landscape, architectural, and cinematic street photography on a full-width 24x65mm film negative with uncompromised corner-to-corner sharpness.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 24x65mm dual-frame panoramic film negative (2.7:1 aspect ratio)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 25mm ultra-wide horizontal field of view with normal 45mm vertical perspective
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops analog negative latitude with expansive horizon dynamic range
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Vertical-travel focal plane shutter up to 1/1000s

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Expansive outdoor natural daylight, dawn or dusk horizontal sunbeams sweeping across the panoramic vista
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Even corner-to-corner illumination with dedicated center filter roll-off, rich natural film saturation

surface_rendering: Expansive 2.7:1 negative resolution: resolved geological textures, horizon detail, and architectural facades
Organic silver halide grain with natural color saturation
High optical acutance across the entire 65mm image plane without digital cropping
depth_and_optics: Deep depth of field across the entire panoramic expanse at f/8 to f/11
True rectilinear panoramic projection with zero barrel or pincushion distortion
Authentic full-width negative rendering without artificial wide-angle stretch

execution_directive: Enforce 35mm film panoramic photograph in an ultra-wide 2.7:1 frame, full-width negative not a crop, even corner-to-corner sharpness, natural film color and grain, shot on Hasselblad XPan.
